notes: Original primary source verified by title: PsyArXiv author preprint bfr5s, acquired after publisher PDF returned 403; Table 1 is on preprint p. 38 rather than the supplied published-page locator. Positive original d denotes higher promotion-condition means. Replication d and p are the same autonomy comparison. Replication Table 1 prints final N = 446, but footnote 4 does not print autonomy analytic N and nearby competence/relatedness dfs (445 and 455) are inconsistent with that final sample; analytic n left null. Footnote 4 reports the directional result but provides no explicit replication-success verdict for this target. The explicit statement that earlier findings replicated in footnote 3 concerns Study 1b high-versus-low need support, so it is not assigned to this effect. No statistics converted.
